title: Preprocessing pipeline protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Preprocessing pipeline should complete this objective: Combine imputation, encoding, and classification. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Build reusable workflows.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Fit the combined pipeline inside cross-validation and test an inference input.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for ColumnTransformer, Pipeline, SimpleImputer and does not run the learner code. Fit the combined pipeline inside cross-validation and test an inference input.
